Separate spatial smoothness does not imply parameter differentiability: g+|s|h is a counterexample. Added joint C-infinity chart smoothness; inverse differentiation is then legitimate. Direct consumers are all owned and use linear, smooth pullback or explicitly smooth model variations; no consumer interface changes are required.

Checked all six clauses as adopted assumptions, not a proof. EH density uses c^3/(16 pi G_N), S-2 Lambda and oriented volume; scalar matter uses dimensionless phi, V in m^-2 and K in J/m. Compact differences avoid a divergent total action. Repaired scope and clause (iii): only the supplied scalar action adopts the variational presentation; prescribed dust/fluid sectors are comparison descriptions of the separate direct equation and never use nonexistent matter actions. Clause (iv) now identifies the precise jointly smooth metric families. All direct consumers use an eligible action model, the conditional action-equation theorem, or the alternative direct equation; no necessary outside interface repair was found. The owning A-page summary now explicitly restricts variational adoption/equivalence to the supplied scalar action and routes prescribed dust/fluid to the direct law.

Checked all seven steps and exact Lie derivative, tensor derivative, pairing, compact Stokes, coefficient and flow suppliers. Corrected step 1.1 expansion: g_bc partial_a xi^c cannot be replaced by partial_a xi_b before accounting for derivatives of g. Clauses (a)-(c) then give Killing iff symmetrized derivative zero, constant affine-geodesic pairing (including constant curves), and a divergence-free current for symmetric conserved T. Clause (d) now quantifies H1-H4 over every compactly supported smooth xi, defines configuration pullback maps on X, and states simultaneous invariance on the diagonal G(s,s). Inverse variation is -(nabla^a xi^b+nabla^b xi^a); compact support permits integration by parts and all chart bump tests force the divergence to vanish. AC_omega is inherited from complete flows; no arbitrary choice is added. Direct outside consumers use only unchanged clauses (a)-(c), not the repaired action criterion.

Read all four steps. J=partial_1 has zero coordinate divergence. Velocities partial_0,partial_2,partial_3 have Gram diag(-1,1,1): this is a timelike face, with spacelike adapted normal -partial_1 and positively oriented ambient tuple. The pullback three-form has scalar coefficient -1; its integral is -1/6, nonzero. Reader title repair is sound; amended the separate incorrect phrase “1-form coefficient” to “scalar coefficient”. Finite simplex volume computation uses iterated polynomial integration on the simplex; orientation reversal changes sign only. Current carrier matched the immutable post-reader item hash before Alpha edits; pre/post hashes differ as reported.

Read all three steps: J=x1 partial_2 has divergence zero and insertion sign (-1)^2 gives x1 dx0 wedge dx1 wedge dx3; its exterior derivative repeats dx1 and vanishes. For coordinate velocity bases, adapted normals +/-partial_2 give +/-x1 while +/-partial_0 and +/-partial_1 give zero. At x1=0 the density is zero; elsewhere it is nonzero. Reader title/notation repair correctly distinguishes pointwise face-flux density from an unexhibited integrated side-chain flux; the remark preserves the actual finite-chain balance theorem. No empirical assertion. Current carrier matched the immutable post-reader item hash before Alpha edits; pre/post hashes differ as reported. The owning B-page summary was surgically corrected to preserve the repaired density/zero-gradient qualifications.

Checked all three steps and all zero/critical cases. For smooth f(x0+x1), dphi=(fprime,fprime,0,0); its dual has squared norm zero and is null only if fprime is nonzero. Second derivatives cancel in the flat wave operator, so V=0 gives the scalar equation, T=K dphi tensor dphi and div T=0. Positivity is K times a square, with kernel a hyperplane only at nonzero dphi, otherwise the entire tangent space. Constant f and isolated critical points are covered. Current hash matches post-reader hash; the reader repairs the overstrong null classification without changing the calculation. The owning B-page summary was surgically corrected to preserve the repaired density/zero-gradient qualifications.
